answer: The harbor counter is kept in voyage and marble makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 5 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
